subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage-ledger architecture and accept shadow discovery during normal cost refreshes as the path toward fixing cross-file fork accounting?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and conservative, but it introduces substantial accounting architecture and maintenance surface whose permanent direction cannot be inferred from tests or contributor proof alone.

options.title: Approve with exact-head proof
options.body: Sponsor the architecture, require isolated runtime proof for this integration head, and merge the four PRs strictly in dependency order.

options.title: Fold safety into integration
options.body: Require the normal-refresh integration to include the later bounding and safety controls before any stack slice lands.

options.title: Prefer narrow scanner fixes
options.body: Decline the ledger architecture for now and continue with smaller current-scanner fixes such as the work in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118.

recommendation.title: Approve with exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Sponsor the architecture, require isolated runtime proof for this integration head, and merge the four PRs strictly in dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy makes broad architecture and maintenance-complexity acceptance an explicit sign-off decision, and the repository owner is the strongest available decision owner.
